info.title: WA Runtime API
info.description: Stable, versioned API contract consumed by WA Studio

message.example: A different synchronization mode is already active

mode.description: FULL reconciles every discovered group; INCREMENTAL reconciles only new, changed, invalidated or stale groups. Omission preserves FULL behavior.

groupsDiscovered.description: Total groups returned by authoritative discovery

groupsScheduled.description: Groups selected for detail reconciliation in this run

groupsSkipped.description: Groups skipped because they disappeared during reconciliation

groupsPending.description: Group reconciliations waiting for their first attempt

groupsRunning.description: Group reconciliations that currently own a processing lease

groupsRetrying.description: Group reconciliations waiting for a durable retry

membersSynced.description: Members observed in successfully reconciled group snapshots; not rows changed

total.description: Total synchronized group records matching all current search and filter predicates

phoneNumber.description: Legacy OpenWA participant number; may be a LID user-part. Use resolvedPhoneNumber.

identityType.description: Normalized type of the exact upstream participant identity

resolvedPhoneNumber.description: Verified phone resolution; null for unresolved or conflicted identities

projectionRevision.description: Monotonic materialized projection revision; 0 means legacy fallback

total.description: Total synchronized member records matching the current search filter

datasetRevision.description: Monotonic group-level member dataset generation. It changes for every committed member insert, update, or delete; zero denotes the legacy projection path.

meta.description: Pagination metadata for the filtered synchronized member dataset

sessionId.description: Gateway session that owns this reusable list

membershipRevision.description: Revision of the static group-ID membership only; metadata edits do not change it.

total.description: Total active saved lists matching the current session and search query

sessionId.description: Allowlisted Gateway session that owns the list

groupIds.description: Initial static membership. Inactive and non-ALLOWED groups remain valid list entries.

expectedRevision.description: Saved-list revision observed by the editor. A stale value returns HTTP 409.
Aggregate revision observed by a legacy editor. Prefer expectedMembershipRevision.

expectedMembershipRevision.description: Membership revision represented by the editor. A stale value returns HTTP 409.

groupIds.description: Complete static replacement set. Duplicate IDs are rejected.

text.description: Legacy text input. Use content instead; exactly one of text or content is required.

content.description: Typed campaign content. Exactly one of content or the legacy text field is required.

scheduledAt.description: Required for ONCE. Ignored and returned as null for IMMEDIATE.

text.description: Legacy alias for text content or a media caption.

revision.description: Revision of campaign content and scheduling.

targetsRevision.description: Revision of the complete target set.

total.description: Total campaigns matching current session scope, search, and filter predicates.

expectedRevision.description: Campaign revision observed by the editor. A stale value returns HTTP 409.

text.description: Legacy text update. Use content instead; text and content cannot be supplied together.

scheduledAt.description: Required when changing to ONCE; null is the canonical value for IMMEDIATE.

groupListNameSnapshot.description: Saved-list name captured when this exact membership revision was applied.

targetsRevision.description: Canonical target-set revision represented by this complete response.

source.description: Latest saved-list source for this materialized target set; null after manual replacement.

expectedTargetsRevision.description: Target-set revision observed by the editor. A stale value returns HTTP 409.

groupIds.description: Complete replacement set. Duplicate IDs are rejected and response order is canonical.

expectedMembershipRevision.description: Saved-list membership revision to copy. A stale value returns HTTP 409.

expectedTargetsRevision.description: Campaign target revision observed by the editor. A stale value returns HTTP 409.

liveLaunchToken.description: Short-lived signed proof required to launch this reviewed LIVE snapshot.

liveLaunchTokenExpiresAt.description: Expiry of liveLaunchToken. Null for DRY_RUN or a blocked LIVE preflight.

expectedCampaignRevision.description: Campaign content revision to launch. A stale value returns HTTP 409.

expectedTargetsRevision.description: Campaign target revision to launch. A stale value returns HTTP 409.

preflightToken.description: Signed token returned by the matching LIVE preflight. Required when executionMode is LIVE.

text.description: Legacy alias for text content or a media caption.

sessionId.description: Must be in the Runtime session allowlist

redis.description: Present for the legacy Redis queue backend.
